<section class="project-showcase" aria-labelledby="drugmatch-title">
<div class="showcase-copy">
<div class="card-topline">
<span class="project-number">01</span>
<span class="status-pill status-released">v1.0.1 · Released</span>

<h2 id="drugmatch-title">DrugMatch-Confidence</h2>
<p class="project-kicker">Interpretable preclinical cancer drug-response prediction</p>
<p>Five real DepMap/PRISM XGBoost bundles produce continuous response, sensitive/resistant classification, calibrated probabilities, conformal intervals, out-of-distribution warnings and SHAP explanations.</p>
<ul class="check-list">
<li>Training-only feature selection and cell-line-grouped splits</li>
<li>Five-fold out-of-fold evaluation with locked GDSC2 validation</li>
<li>Honest release labels: validated, exploratory or insufficient evidence</li>
</ul>
<div class="button-row">
<a class="button button-primary" href="projects/drugmatch-confidence.html">Read the case study</a>
<a class="button button-secondary" href="https://github.com/rsolerortuno/DrugMatch-Confidence">View repository <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
</div>
</div>
<aside class="showcase-proof" aria-label="DrugMatch release evidence">
<p class="proof-label">Release evidence</p>
<div class="proof-stat"><strong>0.84</strong><span>Trametinib strict GDSC2 AUROC · n=20</span></div>
<div class="proof-stat"><strong>0.83</strong><span>Afatinib strict GDSC2 AUROC · n=22</span></div>
<p class="proof-note">Preclinical research only. These are small external subsets and not patient-response models.</p>
</aside>

<section class="project-showcase project-showcase-alt" aria-labelledby="targetintel-title">
<div class="showcase-copy">
<div class="card-topline">
<span class="project-number">02</span>
<span class="status-pill status-preview">v0.5.0 · Research preview</span>
</div>
<h2 id="targetintel-title">TargetIntel-IO</h2>
<p class="project-kicker">Therapeutic-intent-aware target triage</p>
<p>A deterministic platform for interpreting candidate genes in anti-PD-1-resistant melanoma. It avoids one universal score by separating antibody/IO, resistance-biomarker and small-molecule strategies.</p>
<ul class="check-list">
<li>Stable role classification and three intent-specific rankings</li>
<li>Typed, source-linked evidence with mandatory human-review boundaries</li>
<li>Optional DepMap/CRISPR layer that never silently changes the baseline</li>
</ul>
<div class="button-row">
<a class="button button-primary" href="projects/targetintel-io.html">Read the case study</a>
<a class="button button-secondary" href="https://github.com/rsolerortuno/TargetIntel-IO">View repository <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
</div>
</div>
<aside class="showcase-proof" aria-label="TargetIntel current scope">
<p class="proof-label">Current scope</p>
<div class="proof-stat"><strong>300</strong><span>genes in the productive baseline</span></div>
<div class="proof-stat"><strong>56</strong><span>targets in the internal benchmark</span></div>
<p class="proof-note">The benchmark tests implementation consistency. It is not an independent clinical validation dataset.</p>
</aside>
</section>

<section class="project-showcase" aria-labelledby="autopilot-title">
<div class="showcase-copy">
<div class="card-topline">
<span class="project-number">03</span>
<span class="status-pill status-alpha">v0.1.1 · Alpha</span>
</div>
<h2 id="autopilot-title">Dev Autopilot</h2>
<p class="project-kicker">Persistent, auditable development orchestration</p>
<p>Coordinates implementation, adversarial audit and independent review while SQLite records state transitions, retries and decisions across restarts.</p>
<ul class="check-list">
<li>Fail-closed state machine and explicit path permissions</li>
<li>Mechanical scope, test, context and Git-metadata gates</li>
<li>Stops at human review; it never commits, pushes or merges product code</li>
</ul>
<div class="button-row">
<a class="button button-primary" href="projects/dev-autopilot.html">Read the case study</a>
<a class="button button-secondary" href="https://github.com/rsolerortuno/dev-autopilot">View repository <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
</div>
</div>
<aside class="showcase-proof" aria-label="Dev Autopilot design principle">
<p class="proof-label">Design principle</p>
<blockquote>Agents advise, implement and review. Deterministic gates decide whether work can advance. A person retains scientific and merge authority.</blockquote>
</aside>
</section>

<h2 id="mtf-title">MTF Prediction</h2>
<p class="project-kicker">Topology-aware deep learning for membrane proteins</p>
<p>A reproducible research archive screening human and mouse membrane-protein domains for transcription-factor-like sequence features under alternative transmembrane-boundary definitions.</p>
<ul class="check-list">
<li>Human and mouse UniProtKB membrane-protein domains</li>
<li>DeepTFactor inference across no-, half- and full-TMD conditions</li>
<li>Residue-level interpretation with Captum Integrated Gradients</li>
</ul>
